stages.purpose: Fix the product, user outcome, preserved roots, and scope.
Fix the visible reference, state, viewport, and acceptance criteria.
Record rollback, bounded implementation, changed files, and verification.
Compare matching states and require a local evidence file.
Report outcome, gaps, rollback, and next action honestly.

reopenPolicy: Reopening any stage preserves history and invalidates that stage plus every downstream approval.
boundaries: No completion claim without explicit gates
